After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight to Cartagena. You’ll be met on arrival and taken to **Casa Canabal Hotel Boutique** to check in.

Once you’ve settled in, set out on a sightseeing tour of Cartagena, one of Colombia’s most colourful cities. The route takes in historic neighbourhoods with colonial buildings and mansions, modern Bocagrande and the walled district of Ciudad Amurallada.

Next, head up La Popa Hill for panoramic views of the city and port. The Convent of Santa Cruz stands at the top.

Continue to San Felipe de Barajas Castle, the city’s largest fortress, which defended Cartagena against pirate attacks in the 18th century.

The main part of the tour takes place in the Old Town within the city walls. You can enter through the Clock Tower. Inside are old squares, historic mansions and the Palace of the Inquisition, with its ornate gateway.

For souvenirs, you can stop by Las Bóvedas Market. Its small stalls and shops sell jewellery, souvenirs, hammocks and other goods.

You’ll also see Plaza de la Aduana, the city’s oldest square, with its city hall and monument to Columbus, and the Santa Clara Hotel, a former convent in the San Diego neighbourhood.

After the tour, return to the hotel via Santander Avenue.

After breakfast, enjoy free time to explore Cartagena on your own.

At the scheduled time, transfer to the airport for your flight to San Andrés, a popular Caribbean resort island.

You’ll be met on arrival and taken to **Decameron Isleño ALL IN** to check in.
